opportunities.title: FONTAGRO Convocatoria 2027 (annual call for Regional R&D&I Consortia) - expected next cycle
opportunities.funder: FONTAGRO (Regional Fund for Agricultural Technology; sponsored by IDB and IICA)
opportunities.program: FONTAGRO annual competitive call, Medium-Term Plan (PMP) 2025-2030 Flagship Programs
opportunities.deadline_text: Not published. For reference, the 2026 call: 'La convocatoria estará abierta desde el 15 de diciembre de 2025 hasta el 20 de abril de 2026 a las 3:00 PM (Hora del Este de EE.UU. Washington D.C.)'
opportunities.funding_text: 2027 terms not published. 2026 reference (ToR s.4.1): 'El monto total de la convocatoria es de US$1.250.000 ... Se cofinanciarán hasta cinco proyectos, uno por Programa Insignia, con un aporte máximo individual de hasta US$250.000.' Funds delivered in kind via IICA country offices (no cash disbursements); IICA admin charge up to 8.1%.
opportunities.duration: 2026 reference (FAQ): 'plazo máximo de 36 a 42 meses de ejecución técnica y 48 meses de ejecución financiera'
opportunities.eligible_applicants: 2026 reference: regional R&D&I consortia of up to three co-executing organizations from at least two FONTAGRO member countries; one is technical leader; at least one must be a public research entity; must include producer organizations as direct beneficiaries. IICA is the executing agency of all projects.
opportunities.eligible_countries: FONTAGRO member countries (2026 ToR): Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, España, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panamá, Paraguay, Perú, República Dominicana, Uruguay, Venezuela. Associates may come from any IDB member country with own funds.
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: Under 2026 rules, international/regional organizations may join only as 'organizaciones asociadas' with a facilitating/complementary role and their own resources (no FONTAGRO funds). CIAT/Alliance would participate as an associate (contributing staff time as counterpart) alongside national co-executors (e.g., a public research institute as technical lead). Confirm whether 2027 terms change; ToR notes FONTAGRO is 'en un proceso de transición de su modelo operativo'.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: 2026 reference: technical leader must be a co-executor legally constituted in a FONTAGRO member country; at least one public research entity; proposal in Spanish; Word + Excel submitted via online platform.
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Activities must be implemented in at least two FONTAGRO member countries (Colombia and Honduras are members).
opportunities.consortium_details: 2026 ToR: up to three co-executors from >=2 member countries; 2026 FAQ: 2-4 member countries and 'cada consorcio debe incluir al menos cuatro organizaciones'; associates allowed with own funds.
opportunities.cofunding_details: 2026 ToR s.4.2: counterpart (cash and/or in kind) of 'al menos dos veces el solicitado a FONTAGRO'; counterpart is audited.
opportunities.eligible_activities: 2026 Flagship Programs considered: 1 resilient and carbon-neutral cropping systems; 2 livestock systems; 3 scaling/extension; 4 'Revolución digital en la agricultura: robótica e inteligencia artificial'; 5 future food basket/biodiversity.
opportunities.required_documents: 2026 reference: project Word document + Excel (budget, results matrix, POA), signed counterpart/commitment letters from each participant, registration of organizations on plataforma.fontagro.org.
opportunities.application_procedure: 2026 reference: single-phase online submission via https://plataforma.fontagro.org; external panel scoring; >=75/100 recommended to the Board.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Flagship 1 (resilient, carbon-neutral crops) and Flagship 4 (digital agriculture/AI) match EO + crop modelling + advisory tools; 2026 winners included AI-based digital platforms for field decision-making.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Core LAC regional fund; Colombia and Honduras are members; long CIAT history with FONTAGRO consortia.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Team can deliver RS/crop-modelling components; constraint is associate-only role (own resources) and 2x counterpart.
opportunities.recommendation: Pursue. Start building a consortium now (if the pattern holds, call opens ~mid-December 2026 with a ~4-month window). Position CIAT as associate providing EO/AI/crop-model science, with national public research institutes as co-executors.
opportunities.potential_partners: AGROSAVIA (Colombia), Honduran public research institutes (e.g., DICTA), INIA Uruguay/Chile, INTA Argentina, INIAP Ecuador, producer organizations (e.g., FEDEARROZ), universities in member countries.
opportunities.next_action: Check the Convocatoria 2027 page weekly from November 2026; email fontagro@iica.int to ask the expected launch date and whether international organizations can be co-executors in 2027; pre-identify a Flagship 1 or 4 concept and partners.

evidence.deadline_quote: (2026 call) 'Fecha límite para la remisión de proyectos (Fase única) 20 de abril, 3:00 PM (Hora del Este de Estados Unidos, Washington D.C.)'
evidence.eligibility_quote: FAQ 2026: 'otras instituciones de países no miembros de FONTAGRO, pero siempre miembros del BID, y las organizaciones regionales e internacionales; podrán participar en calidad de organizaciones asociadas con un rol facilitador o complementario y con sus propios recursos.'
evidence.status_quote: Official listing shows a 'Call 2027' entry, but its page (title 'Convocatoria 2027') has no content yet; listing states 'Each year, FONTAGRO launches open and competitive calls to co-finance innovation networks.'

opportunities.verification_notes: Loaded 2026-10-14: FONTAGRO convocatorias listing (shows Call 2027 entry), Convocatoria 2027 page (empty placeholder, title only), Convocatoria 2026 page (marked '*Closed Call'), 2026 ToR and FAQ PDFs (text extracted), winners news (3 Aug 2026; Board approved 5 projects on 10 Jul 2026, ~USD 5M). An aggregator claimed a 30 March 2026 deadline and USD 200k cap; official ToR says 20 April 2026 and USD 250k - official values used. All 2027 terms inferred from the 2026 cycle.

opportunities.title: APN Call for Proposals (CRRP and CAPaBLE) - next annual cycle (expected launch Nov 2026)
opportunities.funder: Asia-Pacific Network for Global Change Research (APN)
opportunities.program: Collaborative Regional Research Programme (CRRP) / Scientific Capacity Development Programme (CAPaBLE)
opportunities.deadline_text: Not yet published. Previous (2025) cycle: Stage 1 'Sunday, 30 November 2025, 23:59 Japanese Standard Time'; Stage 2 (invitation only) 'Monday, 30 March 2026, 23:59 Japan Standard Time'.
opportunities.funding_text: FAQ: yearly average of USD 45,000 for CRRP projects and USD 40,000 for CAPaBLE projects; 'A limited amount of funding is available.'
opportunities.duration: 'typically 2 years for regional research projects and 1 year for capacity development projects'; up to 3 years (CRRP) / 2 years (CAPaBLE).
opportunities.eligible_applicants: 'Members of non-profit making institutions based in APN member and/or approved countries can submit proposals to APN.' Independent researchers, consultants and private-sector employees cannot submit. Early-career-led proposals prioritized.
opportunities.eligible_countries: Members: Australia, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cambodia, China, Fiji, India, Indonesia, Japan, Lao PDR, Malaysia, Mongolia, Nepal, New Zealand, Pakistan, Philippines, Republic of Korea, Russian Federation, Sri Lanka, Thailand, USA, Viet Nam. Approved: Maldives, Myanmar, Pacific Island Countries, Singapore. Colombia and Italy are not members.
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: Lead must be a non-profit institution based in a member/approved country. Alliance Asia offices (e.g., Viet Nam) might qualify but the FAQ does not address international organizations. Safer route: national partner leads, Alliance Asia staff as collaborators. Collaborators from non-member countries 'strictly cannot seek funds from APN'.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: Non-profit institution in an APN member/approved country; CRRP must engage at least 3 member/approved countries (developed-country leads must include >=2 developing-country institutions).
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Asia-Pacific member/approved countries; priority topics set by subregional committees.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Global change research and capacity development in APN thematic areas incl. 'Climate', 'Food, water and energy', 'Biodiversity and ecosystems', 'Risk and resilience'.
opportunities.required_documents: Stage 1 summary proposal via APNIS; full proposal by invitation (previous cycle).
opportunities.application_procedure: Two-stage via APNIS online system; applicants may submit to only one programme.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Climate/food-system topics fit; EO/crop-modelling methods acceptable but subregional priority topics not yet known.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Relevant to Alliance Asia hub (SE Asia rice systems, matching the researcher's rice-phenology background); small grants.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Feasible only with Asia-based colleagues/partners as leads; researcher is based in Colombia.
opportunities.recommendation: Monitor; pursue only via Alliance Asia colleagues or a national partner in Viet Nam/Lao PDR/Cambodia (e.g., Sentinel-1 rice phenology/yield forecasting). Low funding size.
opportunities.potential_partners: Alliance Asia office (Hanoi), Vietnam Academy of Agricultural Sciences, Vietnam National University of Agriculture, IRRI (CGIAR), regional universities.
opportunities.next_action: Check the APN calls page in early-mid November 2026 for the new call and subregional priority topics; consult the Alliance Asia team about which entity would lead.

evidence.eligibility_quote: 'Members of non-profit making institutions based in APN member and/or approved countries can submit proposals to APN.'
evidence.status_quote: 'The Call for Proposals is typically launched in November and successful proponents commence their project activities in October of the following year.' Latest listed: '[CLOSED] 2025 Call for Proposals under the CRRP and CAPaBLE Programmes'

opportunities.title: CLIFF-GRADS (GRA / Global Methane Hub / CGIAR Climate Action) - next round, as host institution only
opportunities.funder: Global Research Alliance on Agricultural Greenhouse Gases (GRA), Global Methane Hub, CGIAR Climate Action Science Program
opportunities.deadline_text: No next round announced. Round 7 form title: 'CLIFF-GRADS Round 7: Call for Student Applications. Deadline: Sun, 11 Jan 2026, 11:59 p.m. GMT.'
opportunities.funding_text: Round 6 (CGIAR news): grant of USD 14,000 per student for a research stay; round 7 amount seen only on aggregators.
opportunities.eligible_applicants: PhD students from developing countries enrolled at a developing-country university. Host institutions are research institutions linked to GRA (CGIAR centers have hosted).
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: The researcher cannot apply (not a PhD student). The Alliance could host/supervise a student on GHG measurement/modelling; CGIAR Climate Action co-sponsors.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: Individual PhD student with supervisor letter.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Research stays on agricultural GHG measurement, modelling, mitigation, soil carbon.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: GHG mitigation focus; tangential unless the topic is EO-based emissions/carbon estimation.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: CGIAR Climate Action co-sponsorship; partner/host channel rather than funding for the researcher.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Hosting a student is easy if aligned with an ongoing project.
opportunities.recommendation: Not funding for the researcher; useful only as host/partner channel. Watch for round 8 (previous rounds opened ~Nov-Dec).
opportunities.potential_partners: GRA Croplands Research Group, CGIAR Climate Action program, Latin American universities with PhD programmes
opportunities.next_action: Monitor GRA/CGIAR news in Nov-Dec 2026 for round 8; if a suitable PhD candidate exists, offer to host.
